# Warehouses

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List warehouses

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/warehouses`

Retrieve a paginated list of warehouses with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, partnerAddress, creator, locations, supplierWarehouses, routes | `company,partnerAddress` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse name | `Main` |
| `filter[code]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse code | `WH` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[partner_address_id]` | string | No | Filter by partner address IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/warehouses?include=company%2CpartnerAddress&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Main&filter%5Bcode%5D=WH&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bpartner_address_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",

  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create warehouse

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/warehouses`

Create a new warehouse

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Warehouse name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `code` | string | Yes | Warehouse code. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_id` | integer | Yes | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_address_id` | integer | No | Partner address ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `reception_steps` | string | No | Incoming shipment workflow step value. |
| `delivery_steps` | string | No | Outgoing shipment workflow step value. |
| `supplier_warehouses` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/warehouses" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Main Warehouse",
  "code": "WH-MAIN",
  "company_id": 1,
  "partner_address_id": 10,
  "reception_steps": "one_step",
  "delivery_steps": "one_step",
  "supplier_warehouses": [
    16
  ]
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/warehouses", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Main Warehouse",
  "code": "WH-MAIN",
  "company_id": 1,
  "partner_address_id": 10,
  "reception_steps": "one_step",
  "delivery_steps": "one_step",
  "supplier_warehouses": [
    16
  ]
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```
